divergences.because: the library lowercases ASCII only, and basekit lowercases with JavaScript toLowerCase, so a HUB_CONFIG_DIR differing from a candidate only in the case of a non-ASCII letter (U+00C4 against U+00E4) matches there and not here
JavaScript lowercases the Kelvin sign U+212A to an ASCII k, so basekit reads an argv token kit where the library, lowercasing ASCII only, reads a separator and the token it
JavaScript lowercases U+0130 to i followed by U+0307, so basekit reads an argv token i where the library, lowercasing ASCII only, reads a separator
JSON.parse reads the escape � into a string, and cJSON cannot carry a NUL inside one, so spisor_parse_json refuses the registry and the library answers it as malformed
cJSON refuses nesting deeper than 1000 levels, which JSON.parse reads, so the library answers the registry as malformed
a Java data interface answers null for an optional property that is JSON null and for one that is absent alike, so a plugin cannot observe basekit's icon: null or loader: null
AppHome.candidates is a List<String> and Gson reads the number 5 into it as the string "5", so a Java plugin observes a string where basekit answers the registry's number
